scenario: You are meeting a new group of classmates or colleagues for the first time.
suggested_opening: Hi, I'm [Name]. It's great to meet you all!
practice_prompt: Introduce yourself: mention your name, what you do or study, and one interesting fact about yourself.
example_response: Hi, I'm Ananya. I'm a final-year computer science student, and I love building small apps in my free time.
useful_phrases: In my free time, I enjoy...

scenario: A classmate asks you about your favorite subject and why you enjoy it.
suggested_opening: One of my favorite subjects is...
practice_prompt: Explain which subject you enjoy most in college and why, giving one specific reason.
example_response: One of my favorite subjects is data structures because it helps me think logically and solve real problems.

scenario: You are catching up with a close friend you haven't seen in a while.
suggested_opening: Hey! It's been so long, how have you been?
practice_prompt: Write a short, friendly message catching up with a friend about what's new in your life.
example_response: Hey! It's been so long — how have you been? I just started a new internship and it's been really exciting!
useful_phrases: What have you been up to?

scenario: You are describing your family to someone who is asking about your background.
suggested_opening: I come from a family of four...
practice_prompt: Describe your family in a few sentences, including who they are and what they do.
example_response: I come from a family of four. My father is an engineer, my mother teaches at a school, and I have a younger sister in college.
useful_phrases: I come from a family of...

scenario: Someone asks you to describe a typical day in your life.
suggested_opening: A typical day for me starts at...
practice_prompt: Describe your daily routine from morning to evening in a few sentences.
example_response: A typical day for me starts at 6 am with a short workout, followed by classes until 3 pm, and evening study time.

scenario: You are at a clothing store and want help finding a specific item in your size.
suggested_opening: Excuse me, could you help me find...
practice_prompt: Politely ask a shop assistant for help finding an item and ask about the price.
example_response: Excuse me, could you help me find this shirt in a medium size? Also, could you tell me the price?
useful_phrases: Excuse me, do you have this in...
Do you have a discount on this?

scenario: You are checking in at a hotel and need to confirm your reservation.
suggested_opening: Hi, I have a reservation under the name...
practice_prompt: Politely check in at a hotel, confirming your reservation and asking about checkout time.
example_response: Hi, I have a reservation under the name Rahul Sharma. Could you also let me know the checkout time?
useful_phrases: Could you tell me the checkout time?
Could I get a room with a view?

scenario: You are lost in an unfamiliar city and need directions to the train station.
suggested_opening: Excuse me, could you help me with directions?
practice_prompt: Politely ask a stranger for directions to a specific place.
example_response: Excuse me, could you help me with directions to the train station? I seem to have lost my way.
useful_phrases: Excuse me, could you help me...
Thank you so much for your help.

scenario: You need to ask a colleague to send you a document by the end of the day.
practice_prompt: Make a polite formal request to a colleague for a document with a deadline.
example_response: Would you mind sending me the sales report by the end of today? I need it for tomorrow's meeting.
useful_phrases: When you get a chance, could you...

scenario: Your team is discussing which marketing strategy to use, and you are asked for your opinion.
suggested_opening: In my opinion, I think we should...
practice_prompt: Share your opinion on a work-related decision, giving at least one reason.
example_response: In my opinion, I think we should focus on social media marketing because it reaches a younger audience more effectively.

scenario: A colleague suggests an idea in a meeting that you fully support.
suggested_opening: I completely agree with that idea because...
practice_prompt: Express agreement with a colleague's suggestion and add a supporting reason.
example_response: I completely agree with that idea because it would save us both time and money in the long run.

scenario: A colleague suggests an approach you think might not work well, and you want to respectfully disagree.
suggested_opening: I see your point, but I have a slightly different view...
practice_prompt: Politely disagree with an idea and suggest an alternative.
example_response: I see your point, but I have a slightly different view — I think a phased rollout might reduce the risk involved.
useful_phrases: I'm not sure I fully agree...

scenario: You need to update your manager on the progress of a project during a status meeting.
suggested_opening: I wanted to give you a quick update on...
practice_prompt: Give a brief professional status update about a project's progress.
example_response: I wanted to give you a quick update on the app redesign — we're on track and should finish testing by Friday.
useful_phrases: I wanted to update you on...
We're currently on track / slightly behind schedule.
Let me know if you have questions.

scenario: You are writing a follow-up email after a business meeting to summarize the key points.
suggested_opening: Thank you for the productive meeting today...
practice_prompt: Write a short professional follow-up message summarizing key points and next steps after a meeting.
example_response: Thank you for the productive meeting today. To summarize, we agreed to finalize the budget by next week and schedule a follow-up call.
useful_phrases: Thank you for your time today.
Please let me know if I've missed anything.
